sentence: The woman ___ lives next door is a doctor.
explanation: Who используется для людей: "the woman who lives".

sentence: I bought a laptop ___ has a very fast processor.
explanation: Which используется для вещей и животных: "a laptop which has".

sentence: The teacher ___ car is parked outside is on holiday.
explanation: Whose используется для выражения принадлежности: "the teacher whose car".

sentence: This is the cafe ___ we had our first date.
explanation: Where используется для обозначения места: "the cafe where we had".

sentence: The man ___ called you this morning is my boss.
explanation: Who используется для людей: "the man who called".

sentence: She showed me the photo ___ was taken on holiday.
explanation: Which используется для вещей: "the photo which was taken".

sentence: The student ___ phone rang during the exam was embarrassed.
explanation: Whose используется для выражения принадлежности: "the student whose phone".

sentence: I like the city ___ I was born in.
explanation: Where используется для обозначения места: "the city where I was born".

sentence: The people ___ live on my street are very friendly.
explanation: Who используется для людей: "the people who live".

sentence: This is the book ___ I told you about.
explanation: That используется для вещей и людей, особенно после предлогов: "the book that I told you about".

sentence: The restaurant ___ we ate at last night was expensive.
explanation: That используется для вещей после предлогов: "the restaurant that we ate at".

sentence: The girl ___ father is a pilot wants to travel the world.
explanation: Whose используется для выражения принадлежности: "the girl whose father".

sentence: The office ___ I work in has large windows.
explanation: That используется для вещей после предлогов: "the office that I work in".

sentence: The film ___ we watched yesterday was really funny.
explanation: That используется для вещей: "the film that we watched".

sentence: He is the only person ___ I trust completely.
explanation: That используется для людей после слов "the only" или "all": "the only person that I trust".

sentence: The chair ___ you are sitting on is broken.
explanation: That используется для вещей после предлогов: "the chair that you are sitting on".

sentence: My grandmother, ___ is 80 years old, still goes for walks.
explanation: Who используется для людей в неопределяющем придаточном предложении: "my grandmother, who is 80".

sentence: The museum ___ we visited had ancient Egyptian art.
explanation: That используется для вещей: "the museum that we visited".

sentence: The boy ___ bike was stolen reported it to the police.
explanation: Whose используется для выражения принадлежности: "the boy whose bike".

sentence: This is the park ___ my children play every afternoon.
explanation: Where используется для обозначения места: "the park where my children play".
